mechanism: Both drugs can cause metabolic acidosis and have anticholinergic/CNS effects that may be additive; dorzolamide causes systemic absorption-related metabolic effects while oxybutynin has anticholinergic properties affecting fluid/electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and acid-base status; ensure adequate hydration; use lowest effective doses and consider alternative agents if metabolic acidosis develops.
